import json, subprocess, sys, time, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tools')
from compiler import Job, check_plan, find_deficient_cut
from checkcert import valid_plan, valid_cut

MAIN='/workspace/submission/main.py'

k=32
links=[[i,(i+1)%k,100] for i in range(k)]
p=10**6
demands={i:(3*10**12 if i%4==0 else 0) for i in range(k)}
demands[1]=10**11
env=[[l, 8] for l in range(k)]
parts=[[v, demands[v]] for v in sorted(demands)]

reqs=[]
reqs.append({"op":"load","n":k,"links":links,"bookings":[]})
reqs.append({"op":"prepare","id":"job.big","owner":"team-a","window":[0,10**7],"period":p,
             "participants":parts,"envelope":env,"rev":0})
reqs.append({"op":"commit","id":"job.big","owner":"team-a","rev":0})
# second proposal on a different id, must be denied (capacity) since the ring is full
env2=[[l, 3] for l in range(k)]
reqs.append({"op":"prepare","id":"job.two","owner":"team-b","window":[0,10**7],"period":p,
             "participants":parts,"envelope":env2,"rev":1})
reqs.append({"op":"audit","at":[0]})
reqs.append({"op":"advance","time":10**7})
reqs.append({"op":"audit","at":[10**7]})
reqs.append({"op":"prepare","id":"job.two","owner":"team-b","window":[0,10**7],"period":p,
             "participants":parts,"envelope":env2,"rev":3})

payload='\n'.join(json.dumps(r) for r in reqs)+'\n'
t0=time.monotonic()
proc=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',MAIN], input=payload.encode(),
                    stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=300)
dt=time.monotonic()-t0
print('elapsed', round(dt,2), 'rc', proc.returncode, proc.stderr.decode()[:500])
reps=[json.loads(x) for x in proc.stdout.decode().splitlines()]
for r in reps:
    print(json.dumps(r)[:160])
plan=reps[1].get('plan')
job=Job(k, [(u,v,c) for u,v,c in links], demands, p, dict(env))
print('plan valid:', check_plan(job, plan), 'trees',len(plan['trees']),'routes',len(plan['routes']),'recipes',len(plan['recipes']))
print('indep valid:', valid_plan(k, [(u,v,c) for u,v,c in links], demands, p, dict(env), plan))
print('denial 2:', reps[3])
PY
timeout 300 python3 -B tools/test_big.py
